name: combo_quick_getup
verifies: fix-31: right clicks chain quick attacks (R/L alternating), block + left clicks chain quick attacks, the left combo still chains, the hero sits after a heavy hit until a click and gets up with GetUpAttack / GetUpParade
notes: Run with combatlog on to see one COMBO line per stage. A click lasts 40 ms (no parade raised); the quick attack ends 100 ms after its Hit (G3 _AI_QuickAttack), so 0.3 s clicks are queued and each starts at the previous move's end. The player sits until a click (G3 ZS_SitKnockDown_Loop has no timeout for the player).
